title: 'A clear sense in Israel that Israel hasn't won anything'
summary: Israelis called on Thursday for a state commission of inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, as the country marked 1,000 days since the deadliest event in its history, which triggered the war in Gaza.
